items.information: FMC World 2026 will be held on **Sunday, June 21st, 2026** from **00:00 - 04:00 UTC**. Please pay attention to the date and time zone of your location. Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026) Locations may be added until **June 6th 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates). Note: Registrations on the external website are up-to-date, but registrations will only be added to the WCA website periodically.
